title: should show the AI Observability nav entry after Traces and open LLM Insights
verifies: the OSS left rail renders the AI Observability entry and it lands on the LLM Insights page

title: should render the LLM Insights KPI strip and recent-errors table for an ingested LLM stream
verifies: a seeded LLM stream produces the 5-card KPI strip plus the recent-errors table without the empty/error states

title: should list an ingested conversation in Sessions and open its detail on row click
verifies: a shared-conversation-id conversation appears as a session row and row click opens the session detail page

title: should show only Monitor rail items and hide the Agent toggle on OSS
verifies: the section rail renders only LLM Insights + Sessions and every enterprise rail item and the Agent toggle are absent

title: should show the consolidated empty state when no LLM streams exist
verifies: with no LLM streams the LLM Insights dashboard resolves to the consolidated empty state

title: should show the no-streams empty state in Sessions when no LLM streams exist
verifies: with no LLM streams the Sessions list resolves to the no-streams empty state

title: should re-fetch LLM Insights on refresh without entering the error state
verifies: the page-level refresh re-runs the KPI fetch and stays out of the error state

title: should show an error status badge on a session whose turn span is ERROR
verifies: a conversation containing an ERROR (status.code=2) turn renders an error status badge on the session row

title: should show multiple turns in the session detail for a multi-turn conversation
verifies: a conversation with multiple distinct traceIds surfaces more than one turn row in session detail
